thread:
sam: Quick announcement — we're launching a Community Maintainers Retreat (hybrid) and opening a call for proposals today. Date: Jun 9-10 2025. Form: https://forms.gle/example-cfp. Travel stipends available, details below.

jess: :tada: awesome! what's the CFP deadline?

sam: CFP deadline is May 20, 11:59pm PT. We'll select ~20 sessions + travel stipend recipients. Stipends up to $800 USD, priority for maintainers from underrepresented regions. Hybrid attendance + recordings for remote.

kai: will recordings and slides be shared publicly?

olivia: yes — recordings, slides, and a short write-up will be posted to the community repo and a recap blog. We’ll include short accessibility notes.

jenna: can we nominate folks who mostly do triage/translations but aren't formal "maintainers"?

sam: absolutely — nominations are welcome. The form has a "nominate someone" option. Self-noms ok too.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Community Maintainers Retreat" — Jun 9 10:00 — Jun 10 16:00 PDT (Hybrid). Link: https://calendar.example/event/12345

dan: logistics q: how do stipend payments work for non-US contributors?

mia: ops note — for US folks we'll do ACH/venmo/wire; for non-US we can do invoice or international transfer. We'll follow up during selection with a shortlist for payment details; tax forms may be required depending on country.

alex: can community contributors (not on org) apply to attend / receive stipend?

sam: yes. The main requirement is active contribution or clear impact — the CFP asks about repo contributions, community work, or event proposals.

jess: I'll put a short blurb in the weekly newsletter and share in #community-events.

olivia: also adding a pinned thread in the GitHub discussions and the Maintainers handbook repo.

sam: Code of Conduct applies; travel stipend recipients must agree to COC and an accessibility accomodation form (if needed). If you have questions about travel safety, DM me.

contributor-bot: Reminder scheduled: CFP closes in 3 weeks (May 20).

sam: quick TL;DR: CFP open now -> May 20, apply link: https://forms.gle/example-cfp. Hybrid + recordings. Travel stipends limited (apply even if unsure). Ping me or @olivia with Qs. :sparkles:

jess: :thumbsup:

sam: Heads-up: we'll post selection timeline next week (notification by May 30). Thanks all!
